Key Community Resources
Whole system approaches to care include input from the patient, provider, health care 
system, and other stakeholders that exist within the community. It is important that the 
Nurse Practitioner link patients to needed community resources, that may include:
•• Access to quality, affordable, and healthy food.
•• Safe and convenient places to walk.
•• Adequate and accessible transportation.
•• Affordable exercise programs.
•• Access to affordable medication and diabetes care supplies.
